grammar.pattern: 把 / 被 / 叫 / 让
grammar.purpose: Separate the actor and the affected object
grammar.explanation: 把 introduces a known object that the subject handles: 我把衣服挂好了. 被 introduces the agent of a passive event: 衣服被雨弄湿了; the agent may be omitted with 被. 叫 and 让 can also introduce a passive agent in colloquial speech: 衣服叫雨弄湿了 / 衣服让雨弄湿了. These passive uses require an agent and differ from 叫/让 meaning ask or allow. Do not infer the cause or actor from a bare changed state.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ yī fú guà hǎo le .
examples.en: I have hung up the clothes properly.

examples.py: yī fú bèi yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: The clothes were made wet by rain.

examples.zh: 衣服叫雨弄湿了，也可以说衣服让雨弄湿了。
examples.py: yī fú jiào yǔ nòng shī le , yě kě yǐ shuō yī fú ràng yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: One can colloquially say the clothes were made wet by rain using either 叫 or 让.

commonMistakes.why: For this agentless passive, use 被. With colloquial passive 叫/让, state the agent.

grammar.pattern: 把 + 已知物 + 处所 / 接收者 / 结果
grammar.explanation: Use a known or specified object, then a predicate describing its placement, transfer or changed state. Placement: 把包裹放在门边 / 放到门边. Transfer: 把这本书交给她. Result or direction: 把绳子解开 / 把箱子搬进去. The action alone in 请把书放 is incomplete here. Negation and modal verbs precede 把: 不要把衣服放地上; 可以把书交给她.

examples.py: qǐng bǎ bāo guǒ fàng zài mén biān .
examples.en: Please put the parcel by the door.

examples.py: bǎ zhè běn shū jiāo gěi tā .

examples.zh: 不要把绳子拉紧，先把它解开。
examples.py: bú yào bǎ shéng zi lā jǐn , xiān bǎ tā jiě kāi .
examples.en: Do not tighten the cord; untie it first.

commonMistakes.right: 请把这本书放到书架上。
commonMistakes.why: State the intended placement or other result in this handling instruction.

lines.zh: 你快递到了，我放在门边了。
lines.py: nǐ kuài dì dào le , wǒ fàng zài mén biān le .
lines.en: Your delivery arrived. I put it by the door.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢！你别拆，我订的被子有点大。
lines.py: xiè xiè ! nǐ bié chāi , wǒ dìng de bèi zi yǒu diǎn dà .
lines.en: Thanks! Don't open it yet; the quilt I ordered is rather big.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这么大一个袋子，你一个人拿得动吗？
lines.py: zhè me dà yī gè dài zi , nǐ yī gè rén ná de dòng ma ?
lines.en: Can you carry a bag that big on your own?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 能，你帮我把门打开就行。
lines.py: néng , nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ mén dǎ kāi jiù xíng .
lines.en: Yes. Just help me open the door.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 等一下，袋子下面湿了。
lines.py: děng yī xià , dài zi xià miàn shī le .
lines.en: Wait, the bottom of the bag is wet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 刚才下雨了吧？先别放沙发上。
lines.py: gāng cái xià yǔ le ba ? xiān bié fàng shā fā shàng .
lines.en: Was it raining earlier? Let's keep it off the sofa.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 放哪里？椅子上也有你的裤子。
lines.py: fàng nǎ lǐ ? yǐ zi shàng yě yǒu nǐ de kù zi .
lines.en: Where should it go? Your trousers are on the chair too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我把裤子拿走，你把袋子放到椅子上。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ kù zi ná zǒu , nǐ bǎ dài zi fàng dào yǐ zi shàng .
lines.en: I'll move the trousers. Put the bag on the chair.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这条绳子太紧了，解不开。
lines.py: zhè tiáo shéng zi tài jǐn le , jiě bù kāi .
lines.en: This cord is too tight. I can't undo it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 剪刀在书架上。剪开外面的袋子，别剪到被子。
lines.py: jiǎn dāo zài shū jià shàng . jiǎn kāi wài miàn de dài zi , bié jiǎn dào bèi zi .
lines.en: The scissors are on the bookshelf. Cut the outer bag, not the quilt.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 里面没湿。你今晚就盖这个？
lines.py: lǐ miàn méi shī . nǐ jīn wǎn jiù gài zhè gè ?
lines.en: It's dry inside. Are you using it tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，旧被子明天洗。谢谢你，差点把新被子留在门口过夜。
lines.py: duì , jiù bèi zi míng tiān xǐ . xiè xiè nǐ , chà diǎn bǎ xīn bèi zi liú zài mén kǒu guò yè .
lines.en: Yes. I'll wash the old one tomorrow. Thanks; I nearly left the new quilt outside overnight.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Open before guessing
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我下班回家时，看见门边放着一个很大的袋子。房东帮我收了快递，还发消息说今天下雨，袋子下面湿了。
lines.py: wǒ xià bān huí jiā shí , kàn jiàn mén biān fàng zhe yī gè hěn dà de dài zi . fáng dōng bāng wǒ shōu le kuài dì , hái fā xiāo xī shuō jīn tiān xià yǔ , dài zi xià miàn shī le .
lines.en: When I got home from work, I found a large bag beside the door. The landlord had taken my delivery and messaged that the rain had wet the bottom.

lines.zh: 我想把袋子直接放在沙发上，朋友拦住我，说先看看里面。我把裤子挪到另一把椅子上，两个人才有地方放袋子。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ dài zi zhí jiē fàng zài shā fā shàng , péng you lán zhù wǒ , shuō xiān kàn kàn lǐ miàn . wǒ bǎ kù zi nuó dào lìng yī bǎ yǐ zi shàng , liǎng gè rén cái yǒu dì fāng fàng dài zi .
lines.en: I was going to put it straight on the sofa. My friend stopped me and suggested checking inside first. I moved my trousers to the other chair so we had somewhere to put the bag.

lines.zh: 绳子太紧，朋友拉了几次也没有解开。我去书架上拿剪刀，慢慢剪开外面的袋子，里面的被子没有湿。
lines.py: shéng zi tài jǐn , péng you lā le jǐ cì yě méi yǒu jiě kāi . wǒ qù shū jià shàng ná jiǎn dāo , màn màn jiǎn kāi wài miàn de dài zi , lǐ miàn de bèi zi méi yǒu shī .
lines.en: The cord was too tight to undo. I fetched scissors from the bookshelf and carefully cut the outer bag. The quilt inside was dry.

lines.zh: 我高兴地把新被子抱进卧室，想今晚就用。朋友问旧的放哪里，我说先和裤子放在一起，明天再洗。
lines.py: wǒ gāo xìng de bǎ xīn bèi zi bào jìn wò shì , xiǎng jīn wǎn jiù yòng . péng you wèn jiù de fàng nǎ lǐ , wǒ shuō xiān hé kù zi fàng zài yì qǐ , míng tiān zài xǐ .
lines.en: I happily took the new quilt into the bedroom to use that night. My friend asked about the old one. I'd put it with the trousers until I washed it tomorrow.

lines.zh: 两把椅子都放满东西，我们只好坐在沙发上喝水。朋友笑着说，你现在最需要订的，可能不是被子，是一个更大的房间。
lines.py: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi dōu fàng mǎn dōng xi , wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zuò zài shā fā shàng hē shuǐ . péng you xiào zhe shuō , nǐ xiàn zài zuì xū yào dìng de , kě néng bù shì bèi zi , shì yī gè gèng dà de fáng jiān .
lines.en: Both chairs were now full, so we sat on the sofa with water. My friend joked that my next order should perhaps be a bigger room, not another quilt.

lines.zh: 我把裤子挂好，旧被子搬进卧室，终于空出一个座位。房间没变大，至少明天吃早饭不用站着了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ kù zi guà hǎo , jiù bèi zi bān jìn wò shì , zhōng yú kōng chū yī gè zuò wèi . fáng jiān méi biàn dà , zhì shǎo míng tiān chī zǎo fàn bù yòng zhàn zhe le .
lines.en: I hung up the trousers and moved the old quilt into the bedroom, finally freeing a seat. The room was no bigger, but at least I wouldn't have to eat breakfast standing up.

lines.zh: 我只是想试试软不软。

lines.py: wǒ de wài tào jiào tā ná zǒu le .

lines.zh: 这张纸叫弟弟弄坏了。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhǐ jiào dì di nòng huài le .
lines.en: My younger brother damaged this paper.

lines.zh: 房东明天来修门。
lines.py: fáng dōng míng tiān lái xiū mén .
lines.en: The landlord is coming to fix the door tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我给房东打电话，问能不能养猫。
lines.py: wǒ gěi fáng dōng dǎ diàn huà , wèn néng bù néng yǎng māo .
lines.en: I called the landlord to ask about keeping a cat.

lines.zh: 这张图画了街边的房屋。
lines.py: zhè zhāng tú huà le jiē biān de fáng wū .
lines.en: This picture shows the houses along the street.

lines.zh: 房屋里面很干净。
lines.py: fáng wū lǐ miàn hěn gān jìng .
lines.en: The inside of the house is clean.

lines.zh: 我今天交了房租。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān jiāo le fáng zū .
lines.en: I paid the rent today.

lines.zh: 这间房的房租比那间高。
lines.py: zhè jiān fáng de fáng zū bǐ nà jiān gāo .
lines.en: The rent for this room is higher than for that one.

lines.zh: 我们订了两张票。
lines.py: wǒ men dìng le liǎng zhāng piào .
lines.en: We booked two tickets.

lines.zh: 她想订一个生日蛋糕。
lines.py: tā xiǎng dìng yī gè shēng rì dàn gāo .
lines.en: She wants to order a birthday cake.

lines.zh: 把书放到我包里吧。
lines.py: bǎ shū fàng dào wǒ bāo lǐ ba .
lines.en: Put the book in my bag.

lines.zh: 他把椅子放到窗边了。
lines.py: tā bǎ yǐ zi fàng dào chuāng biān le .
lines.en: He moved the chair beside the window.

lines.zh: 外套挂在门后。
lines.py: wài tào guà zài mén hòu .
lines.en: The coat hangs behind the door.

lines.zh: 我想把这张画挂在墙上。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè zhāng huà guà zài qiáng shàng .
lines.en: I'd like to hang this picture on the wall.

lines.zh: 她帮我解开绳子。
lines.py: tā bāng wǒ jiě kāi shéng zi .
lines.en: She helped me undo the cord.

lines.zh: 先解开袋子，再拿里面的东西。
lines.py: xiān jiě kāi dài zi , zài ná lǐ miàn de dōng xi .
lines.en: Open the bag before taking anything out.

lines.zh: 这双鞋有点紧。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎn jǐn .
lines.en: These shoes are a little tight.

lines.zh: 瓶盖太紧，我打不开。
lines.py: píng gài tài jǐn , wǒ dǎ bù kāi .
lines.en: The bottle cap is too tight for me to open.

lines.zh: 我把旧手机给了弟弟。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ jiù shǒu jī gěi le dì di .
lines.en: I gave my old phone to my younger brother.

lines.zh: 这张旧照片是在北京拍的。
lines.py: zhè zhāng jiù zhào piān shì zài běi jīng pāi de .
lines.en: This old photo was taken in Beijing.

lines.zh: 书架上还有几个空位。
lines.py: shū jià shàng hái yǒu jǐ gè kōng wèi .
lines.en: There are a few empty spaces on the bookshelf.

lines.zh: 我买了一个小书架放在床边。
lines.py: wǒ mǎi le yī gè xiǎo shū jià fàng zài chuáng biān .
lines.en: I bought a small bookshelf to put by the bed.

lines.zh: 猫睡在沙发上。
lines.py: māo shuì zài shā fā shàng .
lines.en: The cat is asleep on the sofa.

lines.zh: 这个沙发坐着很舒服。
lines.py: zhè gè shā fā zuò zhe hěn shū fú .
lines.en: This sofa is comfortable to sit on.

lines.zh: 我把被子拿出去晒了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ bèi zi ná chū qù shài le .
lines.en: I took the quilt outside to air.

lines.zh: 晚上冷，记得盖好被子。
lines.py: wǎn shang lěng , jì de gài hǎo bèi zi .
lines.en: It's cold at night. Keep the quilt over you.

lines.zh: 这条裤子太长了。
lines.py: zhè tiáo kù zi tài zhǎng le .
lines.en: These trousers are too long.

lines.zh: 他的裤子上有一点泥。
lines.py: tā de kù zi shàng yǒu yī diǎn ní .
lines.en: There is some mud on his trousers.

lines.zh: 他今天穿了一件白衬衫。
lines.py: tā jīn tiān chuān le yī jiàn bái chèn shān .
lines.en: He is wearing a white shirt today.

lines.zh: 这件衬衫洗完以后变小了。
lines.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān xǐ wán yǐ hòu biàn xiǎo le .
lines.en: This shirt shrank after washing.

lines.zh: 她把衬衣挂起来了。
lines.py: tā bǎ chèn yī guà qǐ lái le .
lines.en: She hung up the shirt.

lines.zh: 我给爸爸买了一件新衬衣。
lines.py: wǒ gěi bà bà mǎi le yī jiàn xīn chèn yī .
lines.en: I bought my father a new shirt.

lines.zh: 这件上衣和那条裤子很合适。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shàng yī hé nà tiáo kù zi hěn hé shì .
lines.en: This top goes well with those trousers.

lines.zh: 我的上衣留在朋友家了。
lines.py: wǒ de shàng yī liú zài péng you jiā le .
lines.en: I left my top at a friend's home.

lines.zh: 她试了一条蓝裙子。
lines.py: tā shì le yī tiáo lán qún zi .
lines.en: She tried on a blue skirt.

lines.zh: 这条裙子没有口袋。
lines.py: zhè tiáo qún zi méi yǒu kǒu dài .
lines.en: This skirt has no pockets.

lines.zh: 妈妈的皮包放在椅子上。
lines.py: mā mā de pí bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng .
lines.en: My mother's leather handbag is on the chair.

lines.zh: 这个皮包是她自己买的。
lines.py: zhè gè pí bāo shì tā zì jǐ mǎi de .
lines.en: She bought this leather handbag herself.

lines.zh: 这双鞋是皮的。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié shì pí de .
lines.en: These shoes are leather.

lines.zh: 这件衣服用了很软的皮。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú yòng le hěn ruǎn de pí .
lines.en: This garment uses very soft leather.

audio.zh: 剪刀在书架上。剪开外面的袋子，别剪到被子。

audio.en: The scissors are on the bookshelf. Cut the outer bag, not the quilt.

tasks.statement: The scissors are on the bookshelf.
tasks.why: The line explicitly states this detail.

audio.zh: 我把裤子挂好，旧被子搬进卧室，终于空出一个座位。房间没变大，至少明天吃早饭不用站着了。
audio.py: wǒ bǎ kù zi guà hǎo , jiù bèi zi bān jìn wò shì , zhōng yú kōng chū yī gè zuò wèi . fáng jiān méi biàn dà , zhì shǎo míng tiān chī zǎo fàn bù yòng zhàn zhe le .
audio.en: I hung up the trousers and moved the old quilt into the bedroom, finally freeing a seat. The room was no bigger, but at least I wouldn't have to eat breakfast standing up.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三27, 三54. Native check: colloquial passive 叫/让 with rain as agent, 衬衫 versus 衬衣 overlap by region, 皮 as material noun, natural delivery and landlord register, and the personified-sofa joke. No permission to sign for another person is inferred. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三22 / 三47 / 三25 / 三71: 朝门口走，还没说是否到达。, 我在二楼，你上来。, 因为我没核对，我发了旧地址。, 由于通知有错，所以先停止传播旧通知。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: delivery and a wet bag; two friends catching up on a show; noodles with chilli served separately; friends admitting date mistakes. Corrected quilt/chair continuity: trousers move to the other chair, the old quilt joins them, and both are removed before the seat is free. Formal vocabulary uses independent contexts rather than speech that sounds like a report. Replaced abstract caution and assessment-policy dialogue. All target words get two independently authored contexts, and old word/task/unit IDs remain intact. Native flags: colloquial passive 叫, 具有 with formal collocations, 广大 in public notices, the playful eating invitation, 活 as vivid portrayal and 乐 lè as laughter. All distractors and true/false keys were checked against the rewritten facts. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
